definition_quote.value: professional registered nursing means the practice of the full scope of nursing requiring substantial knowledge of the biological, physical, social and behavioral sciences and of nursing theory and may include advanced practice pursuant to the Nursing Practice Act.
definition_quote.quote: "professional registered nursing" means the practice of the full scope of nursing requiring substantial knowledge of the biological, physical, social and behavioral sciences and of nursing theory and may include advanced practice pursuant to the Nursing Practice Act.

methods_authorized.quote: This practice includes but is not limited to: (1) assessing the health status of individuals, families and communities; (2) establishing a nursing diagnosis; (3) establishing goals to meet identified health care needs; (4) developing a plan of care; (5) determining nursing intervention to implement the plan of care; (6) implementing the plan of care commensurate with education and verified competence; (7) evaluating responses to interventions; (8) teaching based on the theory and practice of nursing; (9) managing and supervising the practice of nursing; (10) collaborating with other health care professionals in the management of health care; and (11) conducting nursing research

drug_authority.value: Registered nurses may administer medications and perform treatments prescribed by a person authorized to prescribe. CRNAs may administer general anesthesia and prescribe/administer dangerous drugs and controlled substances (Schedules II-V) within emergency, perioperative, or perinatal care environments. CNPs may prescribe and distribute dangerous drugs and controlled substances (Schedules II-V). CNSs may prescribe, administer and distribute dangerous drugs and controlled substances (Schedules II-V) within scope of specialty practice.
drug_authority.quote: administering medications and performing treatments prescribed by a person authorized in this state or in any other state in the United States to prescribe them

citations.kind: administration of anesthetics, sedatives and general anesthesia

license_tiers.quote: "advanced practice" means the practice of professional registered nursing by a registered nurse who has been prepared through additional formal education...including certified nurse practitioners, certified registered nurse anesthetists and certified clinical nurse specialists

aprn_role_categories.quote: "advanced practice registered nurse" means a certified nurse practitioner, certified registered nurse anesthetist or certified clinical nurse specialist licensed pursuant to the Nursing Practice Act

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "licensed practical nursing" means the practice of a directed scope of nursing requiring basic knowledge of the biological, physical, social and behavioral sciences and nursing procedures, which practice is at the direction of a registered nurse, physician or dentist licensed to practice in this state.
